|p1= building: [[Object]] - (Optional, default [[objNull]]) building

|p4= doorHandleUpAnimation: [[String]] - (Optional, default "") animation source of handle up

|p5= animationPhase: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0) value from 0-1
